and_yet: Orthodox by background but never speaks of it.
does_not_want: Factions using her common room for recruitment.
oddly_also: Knows which faction every regular belongs to and seats them accordingly.
family: Husband Bren runs the kitchen; two teenage children who work the inn.
self_image: The one neutral ground in Dravesa.
recreation: The account books, last thing every night.
dreams: Her daughter takes over the inn; her son goes somewhere safer.
anecdotes: Threw Vraed's men and two Schismatics out simultaneously last Waterday, without calling the watch.
tragedies: Her brother joined the Schismatics last year. She hasn't spoken to him since.
pc_leverage: Best gossip in town. A round of drinks and a reciprocal story.
